common_behaviors_actions: Outwitting enemies with trickery and deception.
Engaging in combat with unmatched martial skill.
Using his magical abilities to transform and manipulate reality.
Sun_Wukong.name: Sun Wukong
Sun_Wukong.hit_points: Dependent on level and Constitution (14d8 Monk + 6d6 Sorcerer)
Sun_Wukong.armor_class: Dependent on Unarmored Defense (10 + Dex mod + Wis mod)
Sun_Wukong.speed: 50 ft. (Base, potentially higher with Mobile feat and Boots of Speed)
Sun_Wukong.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Sun_Wukong.languages: All spoken languages (Tongue of the Sun and Moon)
special_abilities: Martial Arts: Allows use of Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and monk weapons.
Ki: Grants abilities like Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, Stunning Strike.
Evasion: Takes no damage on a successful Dexterity saving throw.
Stillness of Mind: End one charmed or frightened effect on self.
Tongue of the Sun and Moon: Understands all spoken languages and can communicate with any creature.
Divine Magic (Sorcerer): Access to cleric and sorcerer spells.
Empowered Healing: Can reroll dice for healing spells for self or allies.

legendary_actions.Unseen Strike: Sun Wukong uses his speed to make an additional unarmed strike with advantage.
legendary_actions.Mirage (Costs 2 Actions): Creates an illusory duplicate of himself that lasts until the start of his next turn, causing attacks against him to have disadvantage.

actions: Multiattack: Sun Wukong makes two attacks with his Ruyi Jingu Bang or unarmed strikes.
Ruyi Jingu Bang: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 2d6 force damage.
Unarmed Strike: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
bonus_actions: Step of the Wind: Sun Wukong can use a bonus action to Disengage or Dash and double his jump distance.
reactions: Deflect Missiles: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, he can use his reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level.

common_behaviors_actions: Acting as the steadfast protector of his companions.
Using his physical strength to carry heavy burdens and strike down foes.
Contemplating life and death, and seeking redemption for past sins.
Sha_Wujing.name: Sha Wujing, Sandy
Sha_Wujing.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Sha_Wujing.languages: Understands Common, Celestial, and all spoken languages (Tongue of the Sun and Moon)
special_abilities: Unarmored Defense: AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.
Rage: Can enter a rage to gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and a bonus to damage rolls.
Ancestral Protectors: While raging, the first creature he hits on his turn has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than Sha Wujing until the start of his next turn.
Spirit Shield: When a creature he can see within 30 feet takes damage, he can reduce that damage by 2d6 as a reaction.
Martial Arts: Allows use of Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes and monk weapons.
Ki: Grants abilities like Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, Stunning Strike.
Deflect Missiles: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, he can use his reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level.

legendary_actions.Guardian's Presence: Sha Wujing can impose disadvantage on an attack roll made against an ally within 10 feet of him.
legendary_actions.Spiritual Strike (Costs 2 Actions): Sha Wujing makes an unarmed strike that deals an additional 2d10 necrotic damage, symbolizing his connection to the Way of the Long Death.

actions: Multiattack: Sha Wujing makes two attacks with his Heavy Staff or unarmed strikes.
Heavy Staff: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Unarmed Strike: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
bonus_actions: Rage: Sha Wujing can enter a rage as a bonus action.
reactions: Spirit Shield: As a reaction, Sha Wujing can reduce damage taken by an ally within 30 feet by 2d6.

armor.name: Armor of the Guardian
armor.special_properties: Enchanted to provide an additional +1 AC

common_behaviors_actions: Indulging in food, drink, and other base desires.
Using brute strength to overpower enemies in combat.
Attempting to charm or manipulate others to satisfy his needs.
name: Zhu Bajie
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: Understands Common, Celestial, and other languages spoken during his celestial service
special_abilities: Rage: Can enter a rage to gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and a bonus to damage rolls.
Frenzy: While raging, Zhu Bajie can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of his turns.
Reckless Attack: On his turn, Zhu Bajie can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until his next turn.
Great Weapon Fighting: When Zhu Bajie rolls a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack made with a melee weapon that he is wielding with two hands, he can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Combat Superiority (Battle Master): Zhu Bajie has four superiority dice (d8s) that he can use to perform maneuvers such as Trip Attack, Disarming Attack, and Menacing Attack.

legendary_actions.Furious Strike: Zhu Bajie makes an additional melee weapon attack with his Nine-Tooth Rake.
legendary_actions.Intimidating Roar (Costs 2 Actions): Zhu Bajie lets out a terrifying roar. Each enemy within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of their next turn.

actions: Multiattack: Zhu Bajie makes two attacks with his Nine-Tooth Rake.
